dataset: OS OpenMap Local — SX 100 km tile GeoPackage download
evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey's official OpenData distribution channel exposes OS OpenMap Local downloads by area and format, including GeoPackage and 100 km tile delivery from the OS Data Hub. The selected new window is the SX tile, which covers Exeter. The available web channel could not open the api.os.uk download URL, and a direct HTTPS attempt failed at DNS resolution before any response body, redirect target, GeoPackage bytes, layer metadata or ImportantBuilding feature could be read. No record-level geometry or type/use attribute was fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: OS OpenMap Local ImportantBuilding is the target physical-building polygon feature, but no SX tile bytes or record geometry were retrieved in this window.
field_evidence.type_use: Target ImportantBuilding schema carries classification/distinctiveName semantics, but no record-bound SX feature attributes were retrieved.
field_evidence.retrieval: Official public OpenData download URL selected for area=SX and format=GeoPackage; web retrieval was inaccessible and direct HTTPS failed at DNS before payload retrieval.
